en.reason: Anthropic's S-1 reports 90% incremental gross margin and 40% incremental EBIT, while SemiAnalysis's podcast unpacks 85% inference margin, 500% Q1 net revenue retention, 1,368% revenue growth against 300% compute-cost growth and whether the business holds up.

sources.summary: 作者称 Verified AI 迎来标志性月份，Axiom 的 AI 智能体集群用 24 天完成数学史上最长证明的验证，将跨越 500 多篇论文的 15,000 页有限单群分类定理（CFSG）转化为 3800 万行以上机器验证代码，并发现已发表记录中的 34 处严重出入。引用内容补充称该形式化证明可能是最大的开源项目之一，图中显示 Axiom CFSG 达 43.0M 行，约每 37 天翻倍。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 一群 AI agents 核查了史上最长数学证明的每一步，数学家已依赖 Classification of Finite Simple Groups 40多年却无人能独自验完，文章记录 Verified AI 迄今最亮眼的一个月。

en.summary: The author says Verified AI had a landmark month: Axiom's swarm of AI agents verified the longest proof in mathematical history in 24 days, converting the 15,000-page Classification of Finite Simple Groups (CFSG)—spanning more than 500 papers—into over 38 million lines of machine-verified code and finding 34 serious discrepancies in the published record. The quoted material adds that the formal proof may be one of the largest open-source projects; a chart shows Axiom CFSG at 43.0M lines, doubling roughly every 37 days.
en.reason: An Axiom AI agent swarm verified the 15,000-page, 500-plus-paper Classification of Finite Simple Groups in 24 days, turning it into over 38 million lines of machine-checked code and flagging 34 serious discrepancies in the published record.

sources.title_en: Anthropic’s elaborate plan to keep Wall Street at bay

sources.summary: Anthropic 计划通过长期受益信托和 Founder LLC 等独特治理结构上市，在公开市场融资的同时防止股东迫使公司削弱安全投入。信托的五名投票受托人可通过 Class T 股票任命七名董事中的四席，七位创始人则以 Founder LLC 掌握 50.1% 投票权。法学专家认为法律层面可隔绝逐利压力，但市场竞争、融资需求和创始人离开都可能侵蚀这些保障。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Anthropic计划IPO，想靠public benefit corporation身份和限制股东影响董事会的治理设计抵御华尔街压力，Dario Amodei与Daniela Amodei均在董事会，但专家质疑其上市后难守安全优先。

en.summary: Anthropic plans to go public through unique governance structures such as a long-term benefit trust and Founder LLC, raising capital in public markets while preventing shareholders from forcing the company to weaken safety spending. sources.summary: TechCrunch 根据 Anthropic 的 S-1 分析，VC 持股均不足 5%，而 Amazon 可能是 IPO 最大财务受益方。Amazon 持有 62 亿美元本金可转债、其自估持仓价值 979 亿美元，另投 100 亿美元无投票权优先股，累计投资约 180 亿美元；Anthropic 还承诺未来 10 年在 AWS 至少消费 1100 亿美元。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章通过 massive note conversions 揭示 Amazon 在 Anthropic 的实际持股规模，并指出 VCs 虽将在 Anthropic IPO 中获利数十亿美元，Amazon 的收益却会多得多。

en.summary: TechCrunch, analyzing Anthropic's S-1, found that no VC holds more than 5%, while Amazon may be the biggest financial beneficiary of the IPO. Amazon holds $6.2 billion in principal convertible notes, values its stake at $97.9 billion, and has separately invested $10 billion in non-voting preferred stock, for cumulative investment of about $18 billion; Anthropic has also committed to spending at least $110 billion on AWS over the next 10 years.
en.reason: Amazon’s $18 billion Anthropic investment—including $6.2 billion in convertible notes it values at $97.9 billion and $10 billion in non-voting preferred stock—makes it the IPO’s biggest beneficiary, with Anthropic committed to at least $110 billion in AWS spending.
